int8 + Compression is not mechanically interpretable; 8-bit fields carrying Compression may be raw bytes or varints and must be pinned per field. gophertunnel agent/protocol-1.26.40 @5189cf19 (commit "Fix protocol 2168 field encodings") writes io.Uint8(&pk.PlayerPermissions) at minecraft/protocol/packet/start_game.go:319, i.e. a raw byte, so Compression is dropped here. An earlier revision of that branch encoded this as a signed varint; that was the bug the commit fixed.
